keyTakeaways: Built the re-branded homepage and Lived Experience content page for one of Australia's largest mental health service providers. Re-platforming from a Drupal site to a React/NextJS with Tailwind and Payload CMS. paragraphs.text: I built an MVP re-branded home page and generic content page for Today's client, Mind Australia, one of the largest providers of community-managed specialist mental health services in Australia.

Their existing site is Drupal, so for this MVP most of the pages are still served from their old stack; however, we injected web components into their old site to maintain the re-branded header and footer. The new tech stack is React/NextJS with Tailwind and Payload CMS on the backend.

keyTakeaways: Replatformed two websites (Linde MH and Baoli Forklifts) from Sitecore to Next.js/React using monorepo architecture with shared design system. Implemented Storybook components, Vanilla Extract CSS for multi-brand variants, and Sanity.io CMS with custom page builder.

paragraphs.text: Linde MH and Baoli Forklifts (same ownership) needed their websites replatformed from Sitecore to Next.js/React. We had a hard deadline of early February '26, so during the planning stage, we decided on a monorepo approach, which allowed us to build two websites from a single design system. All shared components and modules were built with Storybook, with the only difference between sites being the brand styling. We used Vanilla Extract CSS to enable variant-based styles, allowing us to handle both brand variations from a single stylesheet.
For the CMS, we used Sanity.io, leveraging the customisability of its structure/schema system to build a complete bespoke CMS solution
Each component/module contained its own Sanity schema and query fragment, which fed into our page builder, allowing the client to create unique pages.

keyTakeaways: Built two-page competition site for Kayo Sports/Fox Footy using AstroJS/React frontend with Google Firebase backend. Received 500+ entries during promotion. Launched with celebrity reveal video during AFL Draft coverage featuring commentary skill submissions.

paragraphs.text: The Kayo Sports Call Up! was a short two-page competition site to find the next Fox Footy on-air star who will feature on the new-look Super Saturday LIVE coverage in 2025. The competition required a user to submit their entry with a link to either a YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok video of them displaying their commentary skills.

I built the front-end using AstroJS/React with Google Firebase/Firestore db on the back-end to support the competition entry submissions. The landing page included some hero animations using CSS transitions/animations.
Kayo Sports Call Up! launched via a competition reveal video which aired during the AFL Draft coverage, featuring recently retired Richmond champion Dustin Martin and Fox Footy expert Jack Riewoldt.
During the short four-week promotion, Kayo received over 500 entries.

keyTakeaways: Developed static campaign landing page with interactive course matching quiz using AstroJS so the build could be used in clients php codebase. Integrated SwiperJS parallax slider and React quiz component to forward users to customised course pathways.

paragraphs.text: Open Universities Australia required a new campaign landing page to promote their online study course programs. The landing page included an interactive course matching quiz that forwards the user to an existing OUA page with customised course pathways.

The site needed to be built as static as possible (no React DOM etc.) since it was being hosted on an existing OUA system. I chose AstroJS because it is a static site builder that also allows you to sprinkle in React components or any other framework to add extra interactivity. The parallax slider is SwiperJS and the quiz state is a React component.
